## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| agenda-and-pre-read | `assets/workshop-agenda-and-preread.md`, sent before the workshop | Workshop audience, Plant ME | Purpose, audience and timeframe were agreed with the plant and the pre-read went out, with the reason for the chosen format order |
| workshop-capture-sheet | `assets/workshop-capture-template.md`, filled during the workshop | `funnel-use-case`, `dept-intake`, `bc-portfolio` | Legible to someone who was not present; Every demand is logged against the plant roadmap or returned with a reason; Savings figures marked with their basis as pre-evaluation |
| follow-up-list-and-summary | `assets/workshop-follow-up-list.md` | `bc-build`, `mi-equipment`, `catalog-standardization`, `funnel-first-aid`, Plant ME, by item type | Every item is routed and has an owner role and a date, or is marked "open"; The summary reached the Plant ME |
| utilization-follow-up | Item in the follow-up list (integration workshops) | Plant ME | The utilization session at the next visit is scheduled |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `dept-intake`, `bc-portfolio`, `funnel-requirements`, `invest-screen`
- **Next:** Lane 2 step 21 (define and diagnose, with funnel-use-case) and Lane 3 step 31 (requirements).: `funnel-use-case`
- **Next:** Items go to funnel-use-case or dept-intake, mi-equipment, bc-build (savings calculated as a follow-up), bc-portfolio (ranking), catalog-standardization, funnel-first-aid.: `funnel-use-case`, `dept-intake`, `mi-equipment`, `bc-build`, `bc-portfolio`, `catalog-standardization`, `funnel-first-aid`
- **Stops here when:** the plant has an ad-hoc process issue and no use case (use funnel-first-aid, not a workshop), or an item would commit investment, machine integration or an external connection in the room
- **Stops here when:** Such decisions are made elsewhere
- **Stops here when:** record the rollout dependency instead
